<thought>Search for a Doebner modification template that converts an aldehyde and malonic acid into an α,β‑unsaturated aromatic carboxylic acid (breaks aldehyde and aliphatic carboxylic acid, forms a C‑C double bond and an aromatic carboxylic acid).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "aromatic carboxylic acid"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
